pinned_comment: O que você escreveria na sua carta pro KizuBot? 👇
notes: Per the orchestrator, the concept's whisper-recomendo whisper ('sempre usei umas paradinha…', whisper-recomendo.png) is NOT used; it was replaced by avaliacao-5-estrelas--renovar.png (source avaliacao-5-estrelas.png), a literal recommendation: big type is the verbatim substring 'irei renovar e tbm indicar para meu ciclo de amigos' and the full line is visible in the print. Letter 1 big type trims foda-programando.png to its verbatim start 'na moral vc e foda programando' (full line in the print). Letter 2 stacks trampo-da-hora--zap.png + trampo-da-hora--quote.png (same print, consecutive bubbles; source trampo-da-hora.png). Each letter carries 'print real de cliente'; 'prints reais de clientes diferentes' is on screen in the hook and the finale. Greeting 'A quem interessar possa:' and signature '— cliente KizuBot' are the letter frame, not quotes. Render 2 added the hook line 'o bot que farma no PxG por você' for clarity.
